config_files.notes: Primary graphics, resolution, and post-processing configuration. The Steam install folder (%GAME_DIR%\WellingtonGame\Config\) is the authoritative active runtime path. Legacy user documents paths are not used. Must be set to Read-Only to prevent resolution resets.

Engine scalability and subsystem settings. Must retain root [URL] section defining the entry map (Map=Region_GameMainEntry.umap) and standard UTF-8 without BOM (ANSI/ASCII). If a UTF-8 BOM (0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF) is present, the parser corrupts the first section header to ï»¿[URL], failing map loading and stripping the section. Must remain writable (IsReadOnly = $false).

User-level input bindings and right-stick/look controller sensitivity. In UE3, writing Bindings= entries without leading dot notation overrides the array, wiping inherited bindings. All 174 baseline bindings must be explicitly preserved. Saved as pure UTF-8 without BOM.
Game logic and mobile/touch zone emulation settings. Controls mouse-to-stick acceleration curves and smoothing under [MobileInputZone]. Must be saved as pure UTF-8 without BOM.

Global engine baseline input definitions. Must remain pure UTF-8 without BOM (ANSI/ASCII). If a UTF-8 BOM is present, the parser corrupts ï»¿[Engine.PlayerInput], causing the engine to discard all baseline key and gamepad bindings.

keys.effect: Horizontal display resolution in pixels.
keys.notes: Set to 5120 for native 32:9 rendering on Dual QHD (5120x1440) displays.

keys.effect: Vertical display resolution in pixels.
keys.notes: Matches vertical pixel height for 1440p and DQHD monitors.

keys.effect: Camera focal depth-of-field blur during dialogue, exploration, and combat.
keys.notes: Desktop (<1m on 32:9): Disabling DoF eliminates constant optical refocusing strain across a wide screen and restores sharp environmental clarity. Couch TV / Streaming (3m+ on 16:9): Set DepthOfField=True to restore cinematic depth of field without optical strain.

keys.effect: Radial screen blur triggered by sprinting, rolling, or taking heavy hits.
keys.notes: Desktop (<1m on 32:9): Primary trigger for visual vertigo and nausea, especially on 32:9 where radial distortion stretches severely across peripheral vision. Couch TV / Streaming (3m+ on 16:9): Set AllowRadialBlur=True to restore intended sprint and combat feedback.

keys.effect: Full-screen velocity camera motion blur.
keys.notes: Eye Comfort priority: Disabling motion blur prevents smearing and ghosting across the 5120-pixel wide panoramic view.

keys.effect: Retains motion blur buffer when paused or during menu transitions.
Lionhead HDR bloom and exposure tone mapping pass.
keys.notes: Must remain True. Lionhead's UE3 rendering pipeline couples scene tone mapping and light exposure to the bloom filter. Setting Bloom=False causes the 3D scene to render pitch black with only a pinprick of light in the center. Use DepthOfField=False instead for eye comfort.

keys.effect: Specular highlight bloom flares on metallic and reflective surfaces.
In-engine vertical synchronisation.
keys.notes: In-game VSync in Fable Anniversary causes severe micro-stuttering and irregular frame pacing. Always disable here and enforce frame rate limiting (60 FPS floor or monitor refresh rate) via GPU driver (NVIDIA Control Panel / AMD Adrenalin) or RTSS.

keys.effect: Anisotropic texture filtering level: 0, 2, 4, 8, 16.
keys.notes: Prevents oblique surface blur on distant roads and terrain across ultra-wide angles. Low performance cost on modern GPUs.

keys.effect: Maximum shadow map resolution.
keys.notes: 2048 provides crisp dynamic character and world shadows without edge pixelation.

keys.effect: Hardware Multi-Sample Anti-Aliasing (MSAA) level: 1 (Off), 2, 4.
keys.notes: Keep at 1 (Off). Forcing hardware MSAA in UE3 with DirectX 9 and HDR floating-point render targets causes lighting auras and render target resolve failures.

keys.effect: Real-time point, spot, and directional lights.
Real-time shadow casting from dynamic entities.
Mouse input averaging and smoothing filter.
keys.notes: Disabling mouse smoothing ensures 1:1 raw mouse tracking and prevents camera float, reducing motion sickness.

keys.effect: Variable camera acceleration based on mouse movement speed.
keys.notes: Disables non-linear camera acceleration for consistent aim and tracking.

keys.effect: Maximum engine frame rate smoothing clamp (FPS cap).
keys.notes: By default, UE3 clamps this to 62 FPS. Setting to 144 unlocks high-refresh-rate gameplay.

keys.effect: Minimum engine frame rate smoothing clamp floor.
keys.notes: Raises the frame rate smoothing floor from 22 to 60 FPS to prevent aggressive frame throttling.

keys.effect: Mouse stick-emulation look acceleration curve multiplier.
keys.notes: Default of 12.0 causes extreme joystick acceleration on mouse movement. Setting to 1.0 removes the sticky acceleration curve.

keys.effect: Mouse look smoothing interpolation delay.
keys.notes: Setting to 0.0 removes input lag and camera float.

keys.effect: Mouse look stopping drift inertia.
keys.notes: Setting to 0.0 eliminates camera drift after stopping mouse movement.

keys.effect: System camera rotation sensitivity.
keys.notes: For mouse/keyboard, 0.35 reduces high mouse twitchiness to prevent nausea during camera rotation. For gamepad play, keep CameraSensitivity=1.0 to avoid dampening analog stick turn rate.

keys.effect: Gamepad right analog stick horizontal camera pan binding, deadzone, and speed multiplier.
keys.notes: Default DeadZone=0.2 (20%) and Speed=1.0 cause severe camera lag and sluggish horizontal panning on Xbox and Luna controllers. Tuning to DeadZone=0.08 (8%) and Speed=1.4 provides responsive, smooth camera rotation.

keys.effect: Gamepad right analog stick vertical camera tilt binding, deadzone, and speed multiplier.
keys.notes: Default DeadZone=0.2 (20%) and Speed=0.8 create heavy vertical input resistance. Tuning to DeadZone=0.08 (8%) and Speed=1.1 eliminates vertical stick delay while maintaining precise vertical aim.

engine_overrides.behaviour: UE3 natively implements Vert- cropping on aspect ratios wider than 16:9, severely truncating vertical visibility at 32:9 (5120x1440).
engine_overrides.action: Use Flawless Widescreen with the Fable Anniversary plugin. Enable FOV Fix and Remove Letterbox. On 32:9 resolutions (5120x1440), UNCHECK 'HUD Fix' and 'HUD Constrained to 16x9' to avoid menu black-screen bugs.

engine_overrides.behaviour: In-engine VSync introduces severe frame pacing judder and stutter.
engine_overrides.action: Set UseVsync=False in INI, unlock MaxSmoothedFrameRate in WellingtonEngine.ini, and lock frame rate via GPU driver or RTSS.

engine_overrides.behaviour: Fable Anniversary resets ResX and ResY to 0 (defaulting to primary desktop resolution) and reverts graphics presets on launch if WellingtonSystemSettings.ini is writable. However, WellingtonEngine.ini must remain writable; locking WellingtonEngine.ini as read-only causes an unhandled exception (0x00000001 in KERNELBASE.dll) during early engine initialization.
engine_overrides.action: Set WellingtonSystemSettings.ini to Read-Only (IsReadOnly = $true) after configuring resolutions. Keep WellingtonEngine.ini writable (IsReadOnly = $false), ensure its root [URL] section (Map=Region_GameMainEntry.umap) is present, and save files strictly as UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM.

engine_overrides.behaviour: Lionhead's custom UE3 parser is strictly ANSI/ASCII. Any config file saved with a UTF-8 BOM (0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF) prepends 'ï»¿' to the root section header, causing the engine to discard the entire first section: in WellingtonEngine.ini, ï»¿[URL] fails map loading and crashes on launch; in BaseInput.ini, ï»¿[Engine.PlayerInput] discards all baseline keyboard and controller bindings; in WellingtonGame.ini, ï»¿[Engine.GameInfo] discards game type pointers.
engine_overrides.action: Always write and save all Fable Anniversary INI files as pure UTF-8 Without BOM (ANSI/ASCII).

engine_overrides.behaviour: In Lionhead's modified UE3 rendering pipeline, scene luminance and tone mapping exposure pass through the bloom post-processing filter. Disabling Bloom (Bloom=False) causes the entire 3D world and character models to render pitch black with only a central pinprick of light.
engine_overrides.action: Keep Bloom=True in all profiles. Use DepthOfField=False and AllowRadialBlur=False to achieve eye comfort without breaking scene exposure.

engine_overrides.behaviour: In WellingtonInput.ini, writing Bindings= entries without the leading dot (.Bindings=) completely flushes and replaces the inherited [Engine.PlayerInput] binding array from BaseInput.ini. Truncating this section drops all character movement, camera, and combat input.
engine_overrides.action: Ensure WellingtonInput.ini contains the full 174-entry binding list if defining custom bindings, or rely on clean UTF-8 No-BOM BaseInput.ini inheritance.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Enable 'FOV Fix', enable 'Remove Letterbox', set FOV Fine adjustment to '+0.50' (first step on slider), and UNCHECK both 'HUD Fix' and 'HUD Constrained to 16x9'
manual_only_settings.reason: Restores Hor+ field of view without menu black-screen corruption on 32:9 displays as verified by WSGF.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Tap LT to re-center camera behind Hero
manual_only_settings.reason: An in-game menu toggle for 'Camera Follow' does not exist in the 2014 Anniversary remaster (exclusive to 2005 TLC). The remaster uses hardcoded spring-damper camera tethering (CAMERA_MODE_STRING_AND_CAGE). Tapping Left Trigger (LT) instantly snaps the camera behind the Hero without fighting analog stick or mouse control.
Decouples movement direction from camera angle.

manual_only_settings.location: NVIDIA Control Panel / AMD Software / RTSS
manual_only_settings.recommendation: Cap frame rate to monitor refresh rate (or 141/120 FPS)
manual_only_settings.reason: Ensures smooth 60FPS+ frame pacing without in-engine VSync micro-stutter.

notes: Fable Anniversary runs on a modified Unreal Engine 3 build (codename WellingtonGame).
All INI files must be saved strictly as UTF-8 Without BOM (ANSI/ASCII); any UTF-8 BOM (0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF) corrupts section headers (e.g. ï»¿[URL], ï»¿[Engine.PlayerInput]) and discards sections.
Bloom=True is mandatory; setting Bloom=False breaks scene tone mapping and exposure, causing the 3D world to render pitch black.
Desktop Ultrawide Profile (<1m on 32:9): Disables DepthOfField and AllowRadialBlur to eliminate optical refocusing strain and peripheral motion smearing across 5120x1440.
Steam Link / Couch TV Profile (3m+ on 16:9): Retains DepthOfField=True and AllowRadialBlur=True for full cinematic depth at couch viewing distances.
Gamepad Tuning: Right analog stick deadzone reduced from 0.20 (20%) to 0.08 (8%) with horizontal speed 1.4 and vertical speed 1.1 for responsive camera panning.
On 32:9 displays (5120x1440), Flawless Widescreen is required for Hor+ FOV. Do NOT enable HUD Fix on 32:9 to prevent black screen menus.
WellingtonSystemSettings.ini must be set to Read-Only to prevent resolution resets, while WellingtonEngine.ini must remain writable.
